d: With four weeks left, two of the boats face the challenge of having novice fishermen on board, which could make or break their season.
As the summer comes to an end and the water temperature drops, the bluefin start their migration to the Mediterranean and the Gulf of Mexico.
A stroke of luck helps Pin Wheel close in on leaders FV- Tuna.com, but with just two weeks of tuna fishing to go, they aren't the only boat that strikes gold.
Gloucester's reigning champion, Capt. Dave Carraro, starts the last week of the fishing season with a nearly $20,000 lead over his New Hampshire rival, the Pin Wheel.
The FV-Tuna.com remains in the lead but hasn't caught a fish this week; rival Pin Wheel has two fish on deck and has a third in its sights.
The fishermen of Gloucester, are feeling confident as they take to the open seas in hopes of catching the first fish of the season.
After fishing alone McLaughlin realizes that he needs help, so he brings two college friends on board who lack fishing experience.
With a major storm on the horizon and the fish biting, Gloucester's fishermen have to brave the weather.
Capt. Dave Carraro resorts to espionage like tactics to find what he needs; Capt. Dave Marciano and Capt. Tyler McLaughlin form an unlikely alliance.
Having caught only one fish by the start of week five, Tyler, captain of the Pins Wheel goes to his lucky fishing spot to discover a rival captain is already there.
It's a close battle for the title of top-earning boat as Gloucester's bluefin tuna fleet charges into the heart of the fishing season.
Burdened by the responsibility of providing for their families and crew, the captains grow desperate to catch and tempers flare.
Competition intensifies amongst the Gloucester fleet when tuna become scarce.
Nine weeks into the fishing season, the captains feel the pressure to catch, and several are trying new techniques.
As time runs out in the North Atlantic bluefin tuna season, every boat in the Gloucester fleet feels the pressure.
The crew of the FV-Tuna.com answer a Coast Guard call to help a boat in distress with two men overboard.
With only four weeks left in the season, the Gloucester fleet gets desperate to get a huge catch and old grudges flare between captains.
The FV-Tuna.com has a commanding lead over the fleet, so with only three weeks left, the other boats are clamoring for second place.
With only two weeks left in the fishing season, the Gloucester captains race to bring in record hauls.
